title: lannea stuhlmannii
intro: Lannea stuhlmannii, commonly known as the African cherry, is a plant species that belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in African medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Lannea stuhlmannii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
